_comment: Exceptions for the runtime audits in specs/07-layout-audit.e2e.ts and 08-typography.e2e.ts. Every entry needs a reason; an entry without one is rejected by the audit.

ellipsis.reason: Plate names are user data shortened to fit the viewer; title attributes provide the full text.
Card titles show file names, which are user data of arbitrary length and are shortened on purpose (the full name is in the title attribute and the detail view).
Same: names and tags on cards.
Tag chips on cards collapse into a +N counter by design.
Folder names in the sidebar tree are user data and shortened on purpose, the width is user-adjustable.
Paths and addresses in monospace are user data and may be long.

clipped.reason: The 3D surface clips its canvas, there is no text in it.

fonts.reason: The 3D view draws no DOM text.
Icons are paths; any svg <text> is not part of the UI typography.

glyphs.reason: File names are user data; a name may legitimately contain any character.
